structure.unit: Production and Sale of Agricultural Products
Grading, Packing, and Marking of Apples

text.section: Any person, except a contract or common carrier, who moves or causes to be moved any apples, the movement of which has been prohibited in writing as provided in § 3.2-4505, is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.
Any person who violates any provision of this chapter is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.
